overlap_handling.provenance_subtraction_semantics: Only the contribution originating from the matched selected Batch-2 rule mask is subtracted in BATCH2_RETIREMENT. Contributions independently provided by non-Batch2 rules (such as reconstructed_profile_to_acceptance on g052), explicit user queries, or accepted Analyzer output remain active. Never global string deletion.
overlap_handling.control_attribution: Nonmatching controls use an empty retirement mask; their results cannot establish dependency or retirement validity for the historical owning rule.

pair_phenotype_definitions.PAIR_PRESERVED: T/T — Evidence retained in both CURRENT_COMPAT and BATCH2_RETIREMENT.
pair_phenotype_definitions.PAIR_RETIREMENT_RECOVERY: F/T — Evidence absent in CURRENT_COMPAT but recovered under BATCH2_RETIREMENT.
pair_phenotype_definitions.PAIR_RETIREMENT_REGRESSION: T/F — Evidence retained in CURRENT_COMPAT but lost under BATCH2_RETIREMENT (observed legacy dependency).
pair_phenotype_definitions.PAIR_UNRESOLVED_BOTH: F/F — Evidence absent in both arms (hard rule: F/F is NOT a retirement regression).

strict_retirement_safety_rules.control_accounting: All answered T/F critical evidence losses and grounding/version/provenance violations remain batch safety findings, including no-op control differences; a control difference does not establish a rule-specific dependency. Report negative-anchor behavior separately.

batch_level_verdict_precedence.condition: Any missing/malformed required input, unknown/missing selected rule disposition, nonfinite/missing primary metric, incomplete execution/provenance, protocol violation, shared-plan inequality or downstream Analyzer call. Must supply all five booleans, five nonnegative integer counters, exactly three rule results and all six finite metric deltas; thresholds are immutable.
An active per-rule reference baseline is not reproduced (as defined in per_rule_decision_contract); preserve independently computed rule outcomes and safety receipts.
Some or all retirement candidates retained legacy dependency WITHOUT any critical safety violations.
Any critical retirement regression, grounding regression, wrong-version regression, or invalid provenance recovery observed (including safety failure combined with partial dependency).
All candidates validated without critical regressions, but an aggregate metric delta exceeds bounded tolerance.
All candidate rules validated, zero critical/grounding/version/provenance regressions, and all aggregate metric deltas satisfy bounded tolerances.

component_provenance_subtraction_contrac.canonical_plan: One immutable prospective canonical RetrievalPlan per case, plus a complete ordered contribution ledger frozen before any downstream outcome; identical canonical serialization is supplied to both arms.
component_provenance_subtraction_contrac.projection: An arm-specific non-mutating execution-input projection subtracts ONLY (active selected rule ID, component kind, exact value) contributions in that rule own mask. The canonical plan and original ledger remain unchanged; no arm-specific Analyzer plan is sampled.
origins: accepted Analyzer semantic output with its support record
component_provenance_subtraction_contrac.same_token_multiple_origins: Remove only the masked origin entries; preserve a token/page if any independent origin remains. Keep surviving baseline order and all vocabulary/scope fields.
component_provenance_subtraction_contrac.pre_outcome_gate: Missing/ambiguous provenance, absent expected contribution, non-mask field change, or canonical inequality is INVALID before downstream calls; never guess origin or globally remove a token.
component_provenance_subtraction_contrac.no_op_controls: Empty rule mask and identical execution-input projection. Keep both scheduled cells for control accounting.
component_provenance_subtraction_contrac.implementation_boundary: This is a frozen contract and pure synthetic utility only; D4-A5 executor integration is not implemented or authorized here.

precedence: DEPENDENCY_OBSERVED_RETAIN if any attributable T/F loss, even when another required group is absent at baseline
INCONCLUSIVE_BASELINE_NOT_REPRODUCED if any required active-case baseline group absent and no attributable loss
per_rule_decision_contract.applicability: Every rule requires at least one active direct case with complete traceable masked contributions. Nonmatching historical cases are controls only, not per-rule baseline gates or extra successful retirement observations.
per_rule_decision_contract.batch_reference_baseline_valid: All required evidence groups for the three active direct cases (4 groups total) reproduced in CURRENT_COMPAT. Other answered controls retain their own pair and metric receipts; F/F is not regression.
per_rule_decision_contract.independent_results: Compute and preserve each rule disposition even if another rule or batch-level gate fails; no subset is production activated by this validation.

metric_reference: Read-only semantics of evaluation/scripts/d4_a2_v2_controlled_shared_plan_validation.py and panda_agent.evaluation._matched_evidence_groups; use current approved group contracts and source/version checks, never runtime selection metadata.
